name: Graylog Security
summary: Graylog Security is the SIEM tier of Graylog's log platform. It adds Sigma rule support and machine-learning anomaly detection over Enterprise, with a published starting price of $18,000 a year. A free Graylog Open edition is also listed.

facts.text: Guided onboarding deploys the first Collector from the web UI, with prebuilt content and instant search, according to the security product page.
Sigma rules can be imported from private GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repositories, and every rule type runs through one import wizard.
Impossible Travel Detection flags credential compromise when a user appears in two impossible locations.
The page says correlated signals become verified incidents automatically, and that a case is built and pre-loaded when an asset's risk score passes a set threshold.
Graylog Security adds machine-learning anomaly detection and Sigma rule support to the Enterprise plan.
Graylog Open is free permanently, according to the pricing page FAQ.
